tool.name: Chai-1
tool.description: Multi-modal structure prediction for proteins, DNA, RNA, and ligands

param.name: input_fasta
param.label: Input sequences (FASTA)
param.help: FASTA file with protein, DNA, or RNA sequences. Use chain identifiers for complexes.

param.name: ligand_smiles
param.label: Ligand SMILES
param.help: Optional small molecule ligand in SMILES format

param.name: use_templates
param.label: Use template structures
param.help: Use homologous structures as templates if available

tool.help:
**Chai-1: Multi-Modal Structure Prediction**
State-of-the-art structure prediction for biomolecular complexes.
**Hardware Requirements:** - GPU Memory: ~15-24 GB (runs on NVIDIA GB10) - Disk Space: ~15 GB for model weights
**Supported Molecule Types:** - Proteins - DNA - RNA - Small molecule ligands - Glycosylations - Multi-chain complexes
**Input Format:** FASTA file with sequences. For complexes, use different chain IDs: ``` >proteinA MKFLILLFNILCLFPVLAADNH... >proteinB MKVLWAALLVTFLAGCQA... ```
**Output:** - mmCIF format structure file - Confidence scores per residue
**License:** Apache 2.0 (commercial use allowed)
**Citation:** Chai Discovery (2024). Chai-1: Decoding molecular interactions.
